name: Star Guardian BGM - Invasion
creator: matthewchasm
description:
A scuffed Star Guardian bgm using Summoner's Rift Updated Theme Music. To use, go to settings > sounds (under in-game tab if on client) > set Summoner's Rift Theme Music to Updated (scroll to bottom). Featuring music from Riot's Star Guardian 2017 Invasion PvE event. Alternate version: [https://runeforge.dev/mods/2af52c93-8410-4dcc-ae3e-d158b16f742c/releases](https://runeforge.dev/mods/2af52c93-8410-4dcc-ae3e-d158b16f742c/releases)
